**Community books keep their author's layout**

1.21.1.0.1020.0:
**Performance ×3 · World ×3 · New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×2 · Train ×2 · Behind the Scenes ×2 · Editor ×1 · Compatibility ×1**

### 0.1020.0

**More useful lag reports**

Behind the scenes: lag reports now record what else was slowing the game down besides the train, such as memory clean-up pauses, waiting on terrain to load, and how many creatures are riding along. Nothing changes in play.

- Lag reports can now tell apart memory pauses, terrain loading and busy carriages

### 0.1019.0

**No more freezes when water or lava flows into terrain that is still generating**

When water or lava reached the edge of terrain that had not finished generating, the server used to stop everything and build that terrain on the spot — a multi-second freeze, sometimes chained several times over. The check for what the two fluids should do when they meet now waits until the terrain is ready, then runs as normal, so obsidian and cobblestone still form and the train keeps moving.

- Multi-second freezes at the edge of freshly generated terrain are gone
- Lava and water still turn to obsidian, cobblestone and basalt as before, just a moment later at chunk edges

### 0.1018.0

**Smoother ticks when new carriages join the train**

Each time the train grew by a group of carriages, the physics engine was told about every single block as it was placed — thousands of tiny collision updates in one tick, which showed up as a stutter right after each new group appeared. The train now builds a whole group first and hands the physics engine each finished chunk section once, so joining carriages cost a fraction of what they did. Mining or placing blocks on a carriage still updates collision immediately.

- Far fewer physics collision updates when a group of carriages is added
- New performance counters in the lag log so the remaining cost is visible

### 0.1017.0

**Fewer ruins**

Ruins turn up a little less often along the line.

### 0.1016.0

**No more "non-existent sub-level" errors while riding**

Riding the train no longer fills your log with "Received a sub-level movement packet for a non-existent sub-level" errors. New carriages now reach your game in the right order, so their first movement update never arrives before the carriage itself.

### 0.1015.0

**Smoother streaming into a later phase's terrain**

Entering one of the later phases could freeze the game for several seconds at a time: the pass that clears stray overworld trees and flowers from the freshly generated terrain ran on the main server thread for every new chunk, and the train generates about a chunk a second. That pass now runs on the world-generation workers, skips terrain that has nothing to clear, and only the handful of block removals stays on the main thread. The generated world is unchanged.

- No more multi-second freezes while new terrain streams in around the transition into a later phase
- Same terrain and vegetation as before — only where the work runs changed
- A server config setting can restore the old in-line pass if ever needed

### 0.1014.0

**Your additions to the train break off when they hit things**

Blocks you build onto the train are no longer as tough as the train itself. When something you've added hits a hillside, a tunnel wall or another moving contraption, it breaks off and drops as items, and whatever it hit stays standing. The train's own carriages still plough through terrain exactly as before.

- Blocks you place on the train break off, and drop as items, when they hit terrain or another physics object
- Chests you've added spill their contents when they break off
- The train's own blocks are unchanged: they never break and still carve through terrain

### 0.1013.0

**Work-in-progress carriage builds**

- Builds saved for a future update; nothing changes in play

### 0.1009.0

**Internal improvements**

Behind-the-scenes maintenance work. Nothing to see or do differently in game.

### 0.1008.0

**Small change to clocks and compasses**

Small change to clocks and compasses.

### 0.1007.0

**Generosity in drifting carriages is remembered**

Leaving something good in a drifting carriage's chest for the next traveller now counts in your favour: the echo you leave behind comes back a little friendlier. The better the gift, the more it counts.

**Joining no longer freezes the game, and stepping off the train stays smooth**

Three causes of lag are gone: a freeze of up to a minute when joining a world on hilly ground, a freeze when water flowed near a carriage at the edge of loaded land, and a steady slowdown that built up whenever you were away from the train, which made picking up items and the train's own movement feel late. Ticks now stay fast whether you are aboard or off exploring.

- Blocks changing on a carriage next to unloaded land no longer freeze the server

1.21.1.0.998.0:
**New Feature ×4 · World ×2 · Advancements ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · Compatibility ×1**

### 0.998.0

**The journey takes a new route**

The line now runs through its landscapes in a different order, so some of the places you used to reach late in a run come sooner, and others come later.

- The stretches of the journey have been reshuffled.
- One stretch now blends gradually into the next instead of stopping at a hard edge.
- Structures along the line now sit into the land: the ground climbs over and into them, water flows through them where they stand in it, and they appear in every kind of terrain.
- They gather gradually rather than all at once, and a few now turn up earlier in the journey.

### 0.997.0

**Advancements reveal one step at a time**

The advancements screen now shows only what you've earned plus the next step ahead — everything further along stays hidden until you reach it.

### 0.996.0

**Faulthurst's Favourite hint in every language**

Faulthurst's Favourite now gives a hint before you earn it in every language, not just English.

**Effortless Building follows the editor's mirror, and whole rooms can be test-driven**

In the train editor, Effortless Building now respects a template's mirror settings. Lines, walls, cubes and breaks you make with it appear on the mirrored side too, and its ghost preview shows both halves before you place. One Ctrl+Z undoes both halves. Test the Carriage now works on whole rooms and whole groups, so you can walk through them before they ride the train.

- Effortless Building places and breaks are mirrored in mirror-enabled templates, including its own undo and redo
- The Effortless Building preview shows the mirrored half, even when you build into a template from outside it
- Test the Carriage works for whole rooms and whole groups, with Reseed and Back
- Whole groups can now be set as rare as one in every 1000 groups

**New ground behind you**

Head back along the train past where you boarded and the journey now carries on behind you, in its own order. But the train has to take you there: only ground you cover walking back along the train brings the next stretch closer, while jumping off or flying ahead just pushes it further away.

- Heading back past where you boarded now leads into new stretches
- Only distance covered on the train counts; getting off or flying ahead doesn't bring you closer
- Smoother edges where the strangest stretch gives way to ordinary land

**Dimensional carriages stay clean on later visits**

Deep into a run, a dimensional carriage could appear with bedrock where its void should be, and walking in could bounce you straight back onto the train with "This room lost its train". Each carriage now gets its own space again.

Every screen that mentions Free Play now explains it with the same words: advancements and stats won't be saved. Where you still have a choice to make, it adds that Free Play is a safe space to use hacks and cheats.

- Updated Free Play translations in every supported language

### 0.992.0

**No more holes in the scenery**

Along some of the stranger stretches of the line, the scenery beside the track now fills in first, instead of leaving square holes of empty sky for a while — or for good, if you moved on too quickly.

**Bookshelves and honey blocks trade for 1 emerald**

### 0.985.0

**Some whitelisted mods need a recent Dungeon Train**

A few mods on the whitelist are only approved on newer versions of Dungeon Train, because they rely on support those versions added. Run one on an older version and the run is Free Play until you update.

### 0.984.0

**The whitelist now covers settings changed mid-run**

Changing a Dungeon Train balance setting while you're playing, whether in the settings screen or an in-game config editor, now puts that run into Free Play for good, just like using a tuning command. Changing it back before you quit no longer hides it.

- How the train's mobs fight and scavenge now counts as a balance setting
- So does whether your backpack survives death, and how big it can grow
- The one-click settings reset puts these back to default along with everything else

**Chat tells you when a new version drops**

If a new Dungeon Train version is released while you're playing, a line appears in chat saying which version is out and how long ago it dropped, with a link to what's new.

- Only real releases are announced — never the small automatic ones

1.21.1.0.982.0:
# Dimensions Overhaul 0.982.0

## Number of dimensions
A HUGE boost to the number of dimensions the train travels through. Many custom made for DT, some you may already know and love.

## Shorter Dimensions
Dimensions are now short, pass through more quicker, but it will take longer to pass through them all.

# The Whitelist for Mods
Moving from blacklist to whitelist. Unless whitelisted, mods put you into freeplay. 
The game will boot regardless, only whitelisted will enable high-scores.

## Modpack Additions
* **Advanced Shulkerboxes:** 
* **Sable Pathfinder:** *(Modrinth only for now)*
* **Pigman Villagers:** ;)

## Train Editor Tools
The train editor has undergone some big changes, make it work much better
* **Test the Carriage** works on every carriage and contents template. Ctrl/Cmd+R re-rolls it
* **Frames:** build your own to dress terrain dimensional carriages
* **Doors, beds and tall plants** in block variants, with a new Span button
* **Menus stay put** instead of following you, update as soon as you save, and no longer freeze on first open
* **New** works for whole rooms and groups
* **Save as new** on built-in templates, or keep a local edit
* **Info panel** shows a build's lights and loot
* **My Builds:** delete builds, and tell the reviewer about your build when you submit
* Cmd/Ctrl-click deletes saved prefabs in the creative menu
* Effortless Building breaks now clear block variants
* Big shared builds keep their chest loot, and loading survives a busy server
* Templates with thousands of block variants no longer lag

## Bug Fixes
* No more freezes when editing the train or saving
* Distant Horizons no longer crashes on Mac
* Dedicated servers now create Dungeon Train worlds
* Eyes of ender lead to the same stronghold every time
* Crops in dimensional carriages stay planted
* Trees no longer turn the track into a tunnel

## Bug fixes
- New Biomes are cosmetics focused. New items and mobs on the train will be coming later.

**The far reaches get stranger still**

1.21.1.0.931.0:
**New Feature ×9 · Editor ×7 · Train ×5 · World ×3 · Loot ×3 · Menus & UI ×3 · New Content ×2 · Advancements ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.931.0

**Block variants can spawn switched on**

In the Train Editor's block-variant menu, variants of blocks that hold a toggled state — trapdoors, doors, fence gates, levers and copper bulbs — now have an On / R / Off pill beside the half pill. Set a trapdoor to spawn open, a lever thrown or a copper bulb lit, or pick R to roll it per carriage. Blocks that fall back when a signal stops (lamps, pistons, buttons) don't get the pill. Existing builds keep spawning exactly as before.

- On / R / Off pill on trapdoors, doors, fence gates, levers and copper bulbs
- Random rolls per carriage, so a corridor can mix open and closed trapdoors
- Editor preview shows the chosen state; Random blinks between both

**Deeper floors in dimensional carriages**

An endless plain's floor can now be laid several blocks deep instead of one. Set it from the Floor row and a water floor becomes a pool you can dive into, a stone one solid ground you can dig.

- Step the depth up and down right on the Floor row.
- Water, lava and stone floors all take a depth.

**The line goes on — and up**

Further down the track than anyone has ridden, after a long stretch of ordinary country, the world stops making sense in a whole new way. Keep riding — you'll know it when you get there.

- Another new stretch of the journey, past the last one
- A new advancement for those who make it that far

**Point a block variant at a lock group in one click**

In the block-variant menu, hold a variant clipboard copied from a locked cell and shift-click a row to turn it into a reference to that group. Shift-click an existing reference with a different clipboard to point it somewhere else.

- Shift-click a row with a variant clipboard to make it a group reference.
- Retarget an existing reference the same way.

**Carriage rooms dress for the journey**

Shops, workshops, libraries, mazes and many other carriage rooms now take on the stone and wood of the stretch the train is crossing, so the same room looks different from one stage to the next. The library also gains a new shelf-lined layout.

- Carriage interiors change their materials as the journey goes on.
- A new library layout, wall to wall with bookshelves.
- The leatherworker stocks enchanted armour.

**The strange stretches run longer**

Some of the stranger places the line runs through now last longer before the world settles back to normal.

A whole carriage — a room or a group built as one piece — arrived empty of everything that was not a block.
